categories.main_business_segments: MIRAIT ONE Corporation operates four main business segments: Environmental and Social Innovation, ICT Solutions, NTT Business, and Multi-Carrier Business. These segments are supported by a group structure that includes major subsidiaries such as Lantrovision, TTK, Solcom, Shikoku Tsuken, Seibu Construction, MIRAIT ONE Systems, and Kokusai Kogyo. The group provides engineering, construction, consulting, and maintenance services for telecommunications, social infrastructure, and green energy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering and construction technologies for telecommunications infrastructure, including fiber optic cabling, wireless network installation, and smart infrastructure solutions. It also develops proprietary methods for solar power plant diagnostics using drones and AI, fiber optic sensor-based infrastructure monitoring, and participates in the development and deployment of next-generation solar cells. R&D focuses on efficiency, safety, and quality improvements in construction and maintenance, as well as digital transformation (DX) and AI-driven process automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecommunications carriers (notably NTT Group companies), public sector entities, and private enterprises requiring ICT and infrastructure solutions. The company also serves data centers, utilities, construction, and environmental management sectors. Its end markets span telecommunications, public infrastructure, green energy, and corporate digital transformation.
categories.geographic_coverage: MIRAIT ONE's primary operations are in Japan, with significant activities across all regions. Internationally, the group has a strong presence in Asia-Pacific, including subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Indonesia, India, China, and Australia. The majority of revenue is generated in Japan, but overseas operations, especially in data center engineering, are expanding.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a downstream integrator and service provider, delivering engineering, construction, and maintenance services directly to end customers. It also acts as a midstream player in some segments, providing system integration, consulting, and project management between technology vendors and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating growth in 'Mirai Domains' such as smart city development, corporate DX/GX, green energy, software, and global business. The company emphasizes sustainability, digital transformation, and human capital development, with R&D focused on AI, data analytics, smart infrastructure, and renewable energy technologies. It aims to shift from traditional telecom construction to high-value-added, full-value-chain solutions and to strengthen ESG management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based engineering, construction, and maintenance contracts, as well as consulting and system integration services. Additional income streams include equipment sales, software development, and recurring maintenance/service agreements. The company also receives revenue from public sector projects and green energy initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese and international engineering and telecom infrastructure firms such as COMSYS Holdings, EXEO Group, and Nippon Densetsu Kogyo. MIRAIT ONE is positioned as a top-tier player in Japan's telecom and infrastructure engineering sector, with a growing presence in green energy and digital transformation solutions. It differentiates itself through integrated, full-value-chain offerings and a strong focus on sustainability and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 578.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 27.9 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 17.2 billion yen. The company employs over 17,000 people and has demonstrated steady revenue growth, particularly through M&A and expansion into new business domains. The mid-term plan targets sales of over 720 billion yen by FY2026, with a focus on increasing the share of growth domains and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MIRAIT ONE emphasizes its ability to deliver end-to-end, high-quality engineering and infrastructure solutions that address both social and environmental challenges. Its unique value lies in combining advanced technology, sustainability, and integrated project management to support digital and green transformation for clients. The company highlights its expertise in smart infrastructure, renewable energy, and DX/GX, as well as its commitment to ESG and human capital development, as key differentiators.
